title: Project configuration schema and default settings
description: Implement a typed configuration service and schema in config/default_settings.yaml and settings/settings_service.py to load, validate, and persist runtime settings including camera index, sensitivity, closure thresholds, alert audio, and log options.
acceptanceCriteria: config/default_settings.yaml contains defaults for camera, detection thresholds, alerts, and logging
settings/settings_service.py parses and validates settings using Pydantic or dataclasses
Invalid settings values are caught and safe fallbacks are used
Unit tests verify loading, modification, and persistence of configuration

steps.details: Create config/default_settings.yaml specifying camera.index, detection.closed_threshold (0.75), detection.closure_seconds (1.5), detection.sensitivity, alerts.enabled (true), alerts.stage1_sound, alerts.stage2_voice, alerts.stage3_alarm.
Create settings/settings_service.py with methods load_settings(), update_settings(), get_settings(), and persist_settings().
Ensure closed_threshold is within [0.0, 1.0], closure_seconds >= 0.5, and camera index is a non-negative integer.
Create tests/test_settings.py to test loading defaults, overriding with custom values, and rejecting invalid configs.

technicalNotes: Keep file size under 200 lines adhering to AGENTS.md guidelines.
Persist user adjustments to a local user_settings.json without modifying default_settings.yaml.
